from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document title as it appears in the text (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    legal_case_type: str = Field(description="The legal nature or case type extracted from the document (e.g., '行政非诉执行', '国家赔偿', '民事合同')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[CaseDocument]
